instruction: Mark all emails in the Bills folder as read

rules.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messageAttributes WHERE attributeID = 59 AND value = 1 AND messageID IN (SELECT id FROM messages WHERE folderID = 13)) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages WHERE folderID = 13);

metadata.explanation: Task requires marking all emails in Bills folder (folderID=13, contains 2 emails) as read. The evaluator checks if attribute 59 (read) is set to 1 for messages in folder 13. Verified from database: folder 13 has 2 emails (IDs 44, 45), attribute 59 represents 'read' status.

llm_judge_reasons: SQL query correctly verifies ALL emails are marked as read using equality comparison: COUNT(read emails) = COUNT(total emails)
Complete coverage: Evaluator checks both the read status (attributeID=59, value=1) and ensures count matches total emails in folder 13
Correct data flow: get_vm_file fetches database -> run_sqlite3 executes SQL -> returns 1.0 only if all emails are read
Proper postconfig: Closes Thunderbird to ensure database state is flushed before verification
Logic is sound: Query returns 1 (true) only when number of read emails equals total number of emails in the folder
